plan_name.value: Qualification Account $50,000 (first tab, first 50K card); risk model Option 1 Trailing (listed first) or Option 2 EOD, chosen at purchase and locked
plan_name.quote: Option 1 · No scaling ... Option 2 · Scaling plan · Daily loss limit ... This choice is locked for the life of the account.
plan_name.note: Lead chooses which option to simulate; price identical

billing.value: one-time; 30 days of access; no renewal
billing.quote: Your account is paid once and expires automatically at the end of its access period — no renewal and no recurring charge.

access_period.note: hard clock per purchase; reset does not extend it

max_loss_limit_option1.unit: USD trailing intraday (real time, incl. unrealized P&L and commissions)
max_loss_limit_option1.quote: The trailing drawdown follows your account’s highest value throughout the trading day, including both realized and unrealized (open) profits. It is calculated in real time and includes commissions.
max_loss_limit_option1.note: Drawdown up to $2,500 on the card

max_loss_limit_option2.quote: The End-of-Day (EOD) drawdown is updated once per trading day, after the market closes.

daily_loss_limit_option2.unit: USD soft (trading disabled for rest of day, not a violation)
daily_loss_limit_option2.quote: If your Daily Loss Limit is reached, trading is disabled for the rest of the trading day. This is not considered a rule violation

consistency_rule.note: none found for the Qualification stage (absence after grep)

minimum_days.quote: There are no minimum trading days required to obtain a Master Account.

maximum_days.quote: There is no minimum and no maximum number of trading days

reset_fee.quote: A reset costs $78 and returns your balance to its starting value
reset_fee.note: clears P&L and trading days; does not extend 30-day access

activation_fee.quote: Each Master Account requires a separate one-time activation fee
activation_fee.note: table $50,000 $148; same for both options; today confirmed reports/stage_e28_briefs/pages/A2_bulenox/blx_dev_cms_help_webfetch_20261021.txt

flat_by.quote: All positions must be closed by 3:59 PM (CT).
flat_by.note: Holding positions overnight is strictly prohibited.

pass_review.value: manual review before Master; not automatic
pass_review.quote: Reaching the profit target does not automatically open a Master Account. Your Qualification Account must first be reviewed.

data_fee_professional.quote: CME, CBOT, NYMEX and COMEX data is billed at $116/month on top of your account.
data_fee_professional.note: help Rithmic item says $112 per exchange; non-professional free

stage_type.quote: Funded Account  — a real brokerage account funded by Bulenox and traded with real money.
stage_type.note: inference: only Funded is called real; Fast Track (Master-level) is 'a simulated funded environment' (FAQ)

drawdown.unit: USD, same model as Qualification option; initial threshold 47,500; locks at 50,100 when account value reaches 52,600

daily_loss_limit.value: Option 1 none; Option 2 1,100 soft, removed once drawdown locks
daily_loss_limit.quote: The Daily Loss Limit is permanently removed once the EOD Drawdown locks at the starting balance + $100.

payout_trading_days.quote: complete at least 10 individual trading days;
payout_trading_days.note: next 10 count after previous payout completed

safety_threshold_reserve.quote: To request the minimum payout of $1,000, the account balance must be at least $50,000 + $2,600 + $1,000 =  $53,600 .

consistency.unit: % best day / Total P&L, cumulative over the Master period; reserve included on payout 1
consistency.quote: Your most profitable trading day must not represent more than 40% of your Total P&L for the applicable payout period.
consistency.note: The calculation does not reset after a payout

split.value: 100% of first $10,000 per trader profile, then 90%
split.quote: You receive 100% of the first $10,000 paid from your profile.
split.note: the trader receives 90% of each additional payout;

frequency.value: weekly, Wednesdays; request by Fri 23:59 CT
frequency.quote: Payouts are processed once a week, on Wednesdays.

max_accounts.unit: active Master-level accounts (Master, Fast Track, Momentum Master combined)
max_accounts.quote: A trader may hold up to five active Master-level accounts under one Bulenox profile and one Rithmic User ID.
max_accounts.note: Qualification unlimited; one profile per household since Oct 2026 (TERMS lines 70-75)

breach.value: account closed; Master reset priced individually
breach.quote: The reset fee is calculated individually for each account.

activation_link_validity.quote: Once an activation link is issued, it remains valid for 7 days.
activation_link_validity.note: a Master Account queue exists before the link

entry.value: after 3 successful Master payouts, at Bulenox's discretion
entry.quote: The transition is completed at Bulenox’s discretion and is not automatic after the third payout.

carry_over.quote: Profits, balance, equity or other monetary amounts accumulated in your Master-level Account do not transfer to the Funded Account.

live_rules.note: DLL, split, caps, payout days not public (Funded Account Agreement)

fees_note.value: Rates are all-in: exchange and clearing fees are already included.
fees_note.quote: Per side means the commission is charged for each filled contract on entry and again on exit. Rates are all-in: exchange and clearing fees are already included.
fees_note.note: plus $100/month if connecting via third-party API; professional data $116/month

option1.quote: Standard and micro contracts can be traded simultaneously. One standard contract is equivalent to ten micro contracts.

news.quote: Yes. Trade straight through the economic calendar — CPI, FOMC, NFP and every other release. No blackout windows, no forced position closing, no penalties.

trading_day.quote: The trading day starts at 5:00 PM and ends at 4:00 PM the following day, North American Central Time (CT).

flat_by.value: 15:59 CT all products all stages; no overnight
flat_by.quote: All positions must be closed by 3:59 PM (CT).

bots_allowed.value: yes, user-built personal tools only; both stages (no distinction stated)
bots_allowed.quote: Yes. Bots, algorithms and trade copiers are permitted.
bots_allowed.note: Only user-built tools intended solely for the account owner’s personal use are permitted. Commercial, shared, rented or publicly distributed automation tools are not allowed.

third_party_approval.quote: any third-party algorithm, automated trading software, or other third-party trading technology must be reviewed and approved by the Bulenox management team before use.

api.value: Rithmic via an approved third-party API or Trader Composite interface; R|API product not named; no Tradovate; ProjectX gone since Dec 2025
api.quote: Payment of this fee permits direct connectivity to the Rithmic platform through an approved third-party API or Trader Composite interface

api_fee.quote: you shall be required to pay a third-party API/Trader Composite Software fee of one hundred dollars ($100) per month.

banned.value: scalping algorithms; DTC Protocol Bridge API; 'automated discretional trading'; hundreds or thousands of rapid trades; reckless trades exploiting lack of execution
banned.quote: using “scalping” algorithms, DTC Protocol Bridge API or automated discretional trading in any of the trading environments. Open and close hundreds or thousand of rapid trades by using any trading algorithms. Implementation of reckless transactions in rough markets to benefit from lack of execution.
banned.note: no numeric threshold; profits may be refused

platforms.quote: More than 20, including NinjaTrader, R|Trader Pro, Quantower, Sierra Chart, MultiCharts and ATAS.

server.quote: Under  System , select Rithmic Paper Trading.

oco.quote: OCO — One Cancels Other — functionality is simulated locally on your computer.

sim_fill_rule.quote: We report a fill when the market trades through your price and when the orders ahead of you in the queue, ... based upon our estimate of your position in the queue and market activity, are depleted
sim_fill_rule.note: not documented by Bulenox; forum post by an account named Rithmic (2019) is a pointer only

vps.note: no VPS rule on any firm page

operating_since.note: earliest Wayback capture; third-party sites say 2021 or 2022 [snippet]

entity.quote: Bulenox LLC 1201 N Orange St, Ste 7149 Wilmington, DE 19801

payout_speed_claim.quote: on a regular Master Account payouts are processed every Wednesday.

rule_changes_12m.quote: The subscription is automatically renewed every 30 days until you cancel it yourself.
Trader could have unlimited Qualification Accounts and up to 11 active Master Accounts.

rule_changes_12m.quote: Our company does not provide any kind of algorithms. However, it is not forbidden to use them.
you are the sole authorized Bulenox trader profile holder within your household

rule_changes_12m.quote: All active Master Accounts shall be consolidated into a single Funded Account.

rule_changes_12m.quote: Withdrawal could be requested via ACH/Wire Transfer, Paypal, Wise.

canada.quote: We are proud to support traders in over 100 countries worldwide.
canada.note: Canada absent from restricted list (Wayback 2026-10-08 and today)

kyc.quote: Every trader must complete the Bulenox Withdrawal Information Form and include a valid identification document.

payout_methods.quote: Bulenox does not charge a transfer fee.
